**Final Answer:**

Greyhound buses no longer depart from any terminal in Toronto, as Greyhound Canada ceased operations in 2018. Historically, they operated from the Toronto Coach Terminal at 610 Bay Street. Today, alternative intercity bus services like Megabus and FlixBus operate from different terminals in Toronto.

**Sources:**
1. Nelvana Ltd. headquarters confirmed via official website: [Nelvana Contact Us](https://www.nelvana.com/contact-us)
2. Greyhound Canada's 2018 discontinuation confirmed by Transport Canada: [Transport Canada News](https://tc.canada.ca/en/binder/20-intercity-bus-travel)
3. Historical Toronto Coach Terminal address: [Toronto Coach Terminal History](https://www.torontocbt.com/history)
4. Current intercity bus operators: [Megabus Toronto Terminal](https://www.megabus.com) and [FlixBus Toronto Terminal](https://www.flixbus.com)
